# Document title

## Purpose

State what this document owns and what it deliberately does not own.

## Scope

Describe included and excluded behavior.

## Current contract or architecture

Describe the present system. Do not mix accepted behavior with speculative future design.

## Invariants

- Invariant one
- Invariant two

## Main flows

Describe inputs, outputs, data flow, ownership, failure behavior, and component boundaries.

## Extension or maintenance path

Explain how contributors change this area safely.

## Validation and evidence

List tests, commands, benchmarks, generated reports, or operational checks that verify the document.

## Security, compatibility, and performance

State relevant effects or explain why they are not affected.

## Related decisions

Link ADRs and RFCs. Do not copy their full rationale.

## Known limitations

List implemented limitations, not aspirational features.

## Change policy

State when this document must be updated.
